$ send-mail compose --to a@example.com --subject groceries --body '- milk
- eggs' --no-open
exit 2
--- stdout
--- stderr
send-mail: error: --body: expected string value but got "- milk\n- eggs" (short flag); perhaps try --body="- milk\n- eggs"?
Usage: send-mail compose --to=ADDRESS,... --subject=SUBJECT (--body=BODY | --body-file=FILE) [flags]
Run "send-mail compose --help" for details.
